title: Case 3 · Incomplete code transfer
description: A missing import may come from copying, not from the original suggestion.
expected: The class definition loads without NameError.
diagnosis: The local file refers to BaseHTTPRequestHandler without importing it. The error alone does not establish why the import is missing.
uncertainty: Possible causes include an incomplete original answer, partial copying, or later editing. Compare the source and local file before attributing blame.
suggestion: Check whether the original code includes 'from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler'. Restore the import if it is absent locally.

evidence.text: The displayed local snippet contains no import for BaseHTTPRequestHandler.
Open the original response and the saved file side by side. Compare their first and last lines and the import section.

verification: Confirm the origin of the missing line before concluding that the AI generated incomplete code. Then rerun the local program.
teaching_point: A correct repair does not necessarily identify the true source of the error.
